title: Pure Battlewasp
summary: Battlewasp cards only, paired with generic Insect Extra Deck monsters and staples. Led by the 2024 support wave, the deck swarms low-Level WIND Insects and climbs through a ladder of Synchro Tuners into Level 8 and Level 12 Insect Synchro bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Battlewasp - Rapier the Onslaught discards another Insect to place Battlewasp Wind face-up from the Deck and Special Summon itself from the hand, then banishes itself from the GY to reduce your Insects' Levels by 1.
Battlewasp - Sting the Poison searches any Battlewasp monster on Normal or Special Summon, and Tributes another Insect as a Quick Effect to negate a monster's effects.
Battlewasp Wind searches a Battlewasp monster with less ATK than a Battlewasp summoned to your field up to twice per turn, and treats an Insect you control as a Tuner for the turn.

summary.title: Opening: Rapier the Onslaught + Any Insect
steps: Discard an Insect to activate Battlewasp - Rapier the Onslaught, placing Battlewasp Wind from the Deck and Special Summoning Rapier; Wind triggers to search Battlewasp - Sting the Poison or Twinbow the Attacker.
Normal Summon Sting the Poison to search Battlewasp - Pin the Bullseye or Arbalest the Rapidfire, while the second trigger of Battlewasp Wind adds another extender.

Synchro Summon Battlewasp - Sachi the Ceremonial Bow (treating it as a Tuner), return Battlewasp Wind to the hand for an extra Battlewasp Normal Summon, and climb through Battlewasp - Hama the Conquering Bow into Battlewasp - Grand Partisan the Revolution.

summary.title: Synchro Climbing & Insect Lock
summary.text: Battlewasp - Twinbow the Attacker, Pin the Bullseye, and Dart the Hunter flood the field without using your Normal Summon, while Dart, Battlewasp Wind, and Diabolantis the Menacing Mantis turn non-Tuner Insects into Tuners as needed. Because Rapier the Onslaught, Twinbow, Dart, and Summoning Swarm lock your Extra Deck summons to Insect monsters, the entire 15-card Extra Deck is built solely from Insect Synchros, Xyz, and Links.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Battlewasp - Grand Partisan the Revolution cannot be destroyed by card effects, gains 200 ATK per banished Insect, and Special Summons itself when banished to destroy cards the opponent controls up to your banished Insects and burn for 500 each.
Battlewasp - Hama the Conquering Bow attacks twice per Battle Phase when Synchro Summoned using a Synchro Monster, and reduces all opposing monsters' ATK/DEF by 1000 when it inflicts battle damage.

Battlewasp - Ballista the Armageddon banishes Insects from the GY to strip opposing monsters of 500 ATK/DEF per banished Insect, while Battlewasp - Azusa the Ghost Bow doubles burn damage from other Battlewasp monsters.
Desert Locusts makes a Quick Effect Synchro Summon during the opponent's Main Phase, and Number 3: Cicada King negates a monster effect on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Revival Swarm revives a Battlewasp monster from the GY and banishes itself from the GY to make an Insect indestructible by battle or card effects until the end of the next turn.
Summoning Swarm revives Level 4 or lower Battlewasp monsters from the GY up to the number of monsters the opponent controls.
Battlewasp - Nest Special Summons a Battlewasp from the hand or Deck when your Battlewasp is targeted for an attack and ends the Battle Phase.
